evars.name: Experience Cloud ID (ECID)
evars.description: Adobe Experience Cloud ID set automatically by AEP Web SDK. Primary cross-session visitor identity.

evars.name: Marketing Channel
evars.description: Marketing channel derived by Marketing Channel Processing Rules (rules to be defined in AA Admin).

evars.name: Tracking Code
evars.description: Campaign tracking code captured from the inbound URL query parameter. Native campaign variable.

evars.name: Campaign Source
evars.description: SAINT classification of s.campaign — traffic source (utm_source).

evars.name: Campaign Medium
evars.description: SAINT classification of s.campaign — marketing medium (utm_medium).

evars.name: Campaign Name
evars.description: SAINT classification of s.campaign — human-readable campaign name (utm_campaign).

evars.name: Campaign Content
evars.description: SAINT classification of s.campaign — creative/content variant (utm_content).

evars.name: Device Type
evars.description: Device type auto-collected by AEP Web SDK / AA device enrichment. Supports responsive mobile-first reporting (BRD 103).

evars.name: Geolocation
evars.description: Geo-location (country/region/city) derived server-side from IP by AA. No raw GPS collected (BRD 1802).

evars.name: New / Return Visitor
evars.description: New vs returning visitor status auto-derived by AA. Supports returning-visitor personalisation (BRD 704).

evars.name: Page URL
evars.description: Full page URL of the current page. Baseline global dimension on every hit.

evars.name: Business Unit
evars.description: Business unit / property identifier. Baseline global dimension for cross-property roll-up.

evars.name: Environment
evars.description: Environment flag (production / staging / dev). Backs the Production Data Only segment.

evars.name: Login / Registration Status
evars.description: Visitor registration/authentication state. Supports email-registration and optional-registration tracking.

evars.name: Hashed Visitor ID
evars.description: [Hashed — PII] SHA-256 hashed registered visitor ID for CRM/AEP profile stitching. Never store raw email.

evars.name: Student Cohort Flag
evars.description: Derived student-cohort flag from geo cluster, visit timing and referral source. Not stored as permanent PII; refreshed annually.

evars.name: Page Name
evars.description: Friendly page name for all instrumented pages across the SNF site.

evars.name: Site Section
evars.description: Top-level site section for content grouping and navigation reporting.

evars.name: Page Type
evars.description: Template/page type (home, listing, detail, policy, map, trails). Distinguishes Privacy, Terms, Cookie Policy views.

evars.name: Viewport / Delivery Mode
evars.description: Rendered viewport / responsive delivery mode (desktop / mobile) per approved wireframes.

evars.name: Brand Compliance Flag
evars.description: Flag indicating page compliance with Heritage SG brand guidelines (and presence of standard government disclaimer, BRD 106).

evars.name: SEO / Structured Data Flag
evars.description: Flag indicating presence of Schema.org JSON-LD structured data / indexability on the page (BRD 801–803).

evars.name: Programme / Installation ID
evars.description: Unique ID of the festival programme or installation in context. Also used for QR check-in installation ID.

evars.name: Programme / Installation Title
evars.description: Display title of the programme or installation being viewed/listed.

evars.name: Venue Name
evars.description: Venue associated with the programme / installation within the Bras Basah–Bugis precinct.

evars.name: Content Date / Time Slot
evars.description: Scheduled date and time slot of the programme / installation shown in listings and detail pages.

evars.name: Unlocked Content Status
evars.description: State of optional unlocked content on a programme detail page (locked / unlocked-via-QR / none). Only visible to scanned-in visitors.

evars.name: First Festival Year
evars.description: firstFestivalYear content field from AEMaaCS model — indicates debut year of the programme / installation.

evars.name: Interaction Type
evars.description: Generic interaction descriptor for key user interactions (CTA click, expand, filter, share, etc.).

evars.name: Klook Ticketing CTA
evars.description: Context of the Klook ticketing call-to-action click directing visitors off-site (programme/installation referenced).

evars.name: Map Interaction Context
evars.description: Context of interactive precinct map interactions (pin click, zoom, listing open) on the MapBox map.

evars.name: Location Permission State
evars.description: Visitor's location-permission state (granted / denied) governing proximity sorting and default listing behaviour.

evars.name: Derived Zone Label
evars.description: Client-side derived zone label passed to Adobe Target. Raw GPS never stored server-side (PDPA).

evars.name: Venue Crowd Density Level
evars.description: Live per-venue crowd density indicator level derived from real-time AA session data (low / medium / high).

evars.name: Trail Name
evars.description: Name of the curated self-guided trail being presented, selected or followed.

evars.name: Trail / Itinerary ID
evars.description: Unique ID of the trail or custom itinerary (used for save/follow, sharing, adoption and Community Picks).

evars.name: Itinerary Source
evars.description: Origin of the itinerary in context (self-created / shared-view / one-tap-adopted / community-pick).

evars.name: Itinerary Optimisation Suggestion
evars.description: Type of inline optimisation suggestion surfaced for itinerary conflicts/inefficiencies (dismissible, non-blocking).

evars.name: Registration Trigger Moment
evars.description: The moment/context that triggered registration (QR first scan, itinerary adoption, save trail, manual). Drives funnel-by-trigger reporting.

evars.name: Consent Tier Selection
evars.description: Three-tier consent model selection captured at registration (Tier 0 Functional / Tier 1 Festival Marketing / Tier 2 Year-Round NHB).

evars.name: Consent Action
evars.description: Consent action captured for the consent log (grant / withdraw) by tier, effective immediately via self-service settings.

evars.name: Cookie Consent Category
evars.description: Cookie consent categories accepted (Strictly Necessary / Analytics & Performance / Personalisation & Targeting).

evars.name: Personalisation Use Case
evars.description: Active Adobe Target personalisation use case in context (your-picks / trending-circle / returning-banner / last-chance).

evars.name: Recommendation Context
evars.description: Context of an affinity-matched recommendation shown or clicked (feed position, programme recommended).

evars.name: Share Method
evars.description: Method used for itinerary sharing via native device share (no social OAuth). Captures channel chosen by OS share sheet.

evars.name: Brand Concierge Intent
evars.description: Visitor intent classified in a Brand Concierge interaction (programme discovery / trail recommendation / venue info / general info).

evars.name: Brand Concierge Outcome
evars.description: Outcome of a Brand Concierge interaction (answered / escalated / failed) for engagement and escalation-rate reporting.

evars.name: AI / Agentic Discovery Source
evars.description: Referral source indicating discovery via AI-powered/agentic search or LLM crawler (GEO/LLMO). Captured from referrer/UA heuristics.

props.name: Marketing Channel
props.description: OOTB marketing channel reporting — mirror of the OOTB dimension; no custom prop allocated.

props.name: Page URL
props.description: Mirror of the Page URL eVar for PathFinder / pathing analysis. Baseline variable.

props.name: Business Unit
props.description: Mirror of the Business Unit eVar for pathing / ClickMap segmentation. Baseline variable.

props.name: Page Name
props.description: Mirror of the Page Name eVar for PathFinder pathing across the SNF site. Supports page-tagging requirement.

props.name: Site Section
props.description: Mirror of the Site Section eVar for next-page-flow pathing through the SNF site hierarchy.

props.name: Page Type
props.description: Mirror of the Page Type eVar for pathing between listing, detail and policy page templates.

props.name: Programme / Installation Name
props.description: Mirror of the Programme / Installation Name eVar for pathing across festival content items.

props.name: Venue Name
props.description: Mirror of the Venue Name eVar for pathing / ClickMap of precinct venue interactions.

props.name: Trail Name
props.description: Mirror of the Trail Name eVar for pathing through curated and custom trail flows.

props.name: Registration Trigger Moment
props.description: Mirror of the Registration Trigger Moment eVar for pathing analysis of which moment drove registration (QR scan, trail save, share adoption).

props.name: Brand Concierge Query Intent
props.description: Mirror of the Brand Concierge Query Intent eVar for pathing of intent sequences within concierge sessions.
